_doc: Character styles of the channel. prompts.py picks one (--style, else brief.json, else 'default') and assembles every Flow prompt from it. Slots: {costume} in 'character' is filled from brief.json character.costume, else from the style's own 'costume'. 'thumbnail' is a template for the thumbnail prompt (filled by hand or by the orchestrator). 'qc' is the short description given to the Image QC agent. Human-readable catalogue: references/character-styles.md. 'insert_prefix' replaces 'prefix' for icon/schema/metaphor/map (plain background, no painted set). 'scene_bg_nochar' replaces 'scene_bg' on scenes without the recurring character. The character sheet goes into scene shots only; a metaphor gets it only with withchar: true.

stickman-meme.label: Stickman meme : grosse tête ronde blanche, visage rage-comic, trait noir épais, décor peint saturé (miniatures Galon Zéro)
stickman-meme.prefix: Bold cartoon illustration, thick black ink outlines, saturated colours, fully painted detailed background with depth and dramatic lighting, 16:9 wide format.
stickman-meme.character: Recurring character: a classic meme stick figure with a very large smooth white round head, simple hand-drawn black eyes, expressive eyebrows and mouth in rage-comic style, a thin white body with simple rounded hands, {costume}. Keep this exact character design in every image.
stickman-meme.costume: wearing a plain grey t-shirt and dark trousers
stickman-meme.scene_bg: Full painted set with real depth, the character medium to large in the frame; any other people are smaller grey stick figures with blank faces.
stickman-meme.insert_bg: Plain off-white background with a subtle paper texture, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred with generous empty space.
stickman-meme.dark: Dark variant: same drawing style, but a night scene with deep blue shadows and a single warm light source.
stickman-meme.dark_scene_bg: Full painted set at night, deep blue shadows, one warm light source.
stickman-meme.dark_insert_bg: Dark navy background, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred.
stickman-meme.pov_hands: the character's simple white cartoon hands visible at the bottom of the frame
stickman-meme.suffix: no text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no signs, no labels, no watermark.
stickman-meme.thumbnail: {prefix} Split composition with a thin vertical divider: on the left half {character} sweating, worried, mouth trembling, {situation_before}; on the right half the same character {costume_after}, smug half-closed eyes and a confident smile, {situation_after}; {setting}; a large empty band across the top for text. {suffix}
stickman-meme.qc: very large smooth white round head, rage-comic face (simple black eyes, expressive eyebrows, hand-drawn mouth), thin white body, thick black outlines; other people are grey faceless stick figures; costume as given in the brief
stickman-meme.insert_prefix: Bold cartoon illustration, thick black ink outlines, saturated colours, flat plain background, 16:9 wide format.
stickman-meme.scene_bg_nochar: Full painted set with real depth; any people are small grey stick figures with blank faces.

egg-headphones.label: Tête d'œuf et casque orange : storybook crème, crayon doux (style maison d'origine, validé sur 65 images)
egg-headphones.prefix: Modern storybook illustration, soft textured pencil shading, gentle ambient lighting, clean minimalist composition, generous empty space, 16:9 wide format.
egg-headphones.character: Recurring character: a whimsical figure with a smooth matte white egg for a head, small dark dot eyes and thin expressive eyebrows, thin stick-figure arms and legs, wearing a simple dusty-blue t-shirt and dark mittens, with large vintage over-ear headphones in warm orange-brown leather tones around the egg head. Keep this exact character design in every image.
egg-headphones.scene_bg: Full coloured set with simple flat shapes and a soft gradient sky or wall, the character small to medium in the frame.
egg-headphones.insert_bg: Plain cream-coloured paper background, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred with generous empty space.
egg-headphones.dark: Dark variant: same drawing style, but a dark slate-blue background instead of cream, with a single warm orange light source.
egg-headphones.dark_scene_bg: Full coloured set at night, dark slate-blue tones, one warm light source.
egg-headphones.dark_insert_bg: Dark slate-blue background, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred.
egg-headphones.pov_hands: the character's mitten hands visible at the bottom of the frame
egg-headphones.suffix: no text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no signs, no labels, no watermark.
egg-headphones.thumbnail: {prefix} {character} Close-up of the character on the right half of the frame, the left half empty, dark slate-blue background with a single warm orange light, {emotion}, holding {prop}. {suffix}
egg-headphones.qc: smooth white egg head, large orange-brown over-ear headphones, dusty-blue t-shirt, dark mittens, thin stick limbs
egg-headphones.insert_prefix: Modern storybook illustration, soft textured pencil shading, clean minimalist composition, generous empty space, 16:9 wide format.
egg-headphones.scene_bg_nochar: Full coloured set with simple flat shapes and a soft gradient sky or wall; any people are small simple figures in the background.

caveman-duo.label: Duo d'hommes des cavernes cartoon : gros yeux, membres en batons, couleurs saturées. Miniature unique de la chaîne The Hidden Bargain (thumbnail_style), jamais l'intérieur.
caveman-duo.prefix: Bold cartoon illustration, thick black ink outlines, saturated colours, painted background with depth, 16:9 wide format.
caveman-duo.character: Recurring characters: two expressive caveman mascots, a man and a woman, in spotted fur tunics, messy brown hair, big round eyes, thin stick limbs, {costume}. Keep these exact character designs in every image.
caveman-duo.scene_bg: Full painted set of the place described above, the pair medium in the frame.
caveman-duo.insert_bg: Plain off-white background, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred with generous empty space.
caveman-duo.dark: Dark variant: same drawing style, a night palette with deep blue shadows and one warm light source as described in the scene.
caveman-duo.dark_scene_bg: Full painted set at night, deep blue shadows.
caveman-duo.dark_insert_bg: Dark navy background, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred.
caveman-duo.pov_hands: the character's cartoon hands visible at the bottom of the frame
caveman-duo.suffix: no text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no signs, no labels, no watermark.
caveman-duo.thumbnail: {prefix} {character} {emotion} (shock, sweat drops, tears), one single prop that says the subject: {prop}, {setting} at {moment}, a large empty band across the top for text. {suffix}
caveman-duo.qc: two cavemen (man and woman), spotted fur tunics, messy brown hair, big round eyes, thin stick limbs
caveman-duo.insert_prefix: Bold cartoon illustration, thick black ink outlines, saturated colours, flat plain background, 16:9 wide format.
caveman-duo.scene_bg_nochar: Full painted set of the place described above, the figure drawn plainer and less detailed than a mascot.

storybook-human.label: Humain peint, style film d'animation années 90 : un protagoniste réaliste, décors peints chauds (intérieur des vidéos Galon Zéro)

storybook-human.scene_bg: Full painted set with depth and period-accurate props, the character medium in the frame, other people drawn with the same care.
storybook-human.insert_bg: Plain parchment-coloured background, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred with generous empty space.
storybook-human.dark: Dark variant: same painting style, night interior lit by a single oil lamp or bare bulb, deep brown shadows.
storybook-human.dark_scene_bg: Full painted set at night, one lamp as the only light, deep brown shadows.
storybook-human.dark_insert_bg: Dark brown background, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred.
storybook-human.pov_hands: the character's hands visible at the bottom of the frame
storybook-human.suffix: no text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no signs, no labels, no watermark.
storybook-human.thumbnail: {prefix} {character} Close-up, {emotion}, {prop}, {setting}, a large empty band across the top for text. {suffix}
storybook-human.qc: young man, short black hair, round calm face, thick eyebrows, costume as given in the brief; painterly anime style, no outlines thicker than a pencil line

storybook-human.scene_bg_nochar: Full painted set with depth and period-accurate props; any people drawn with the same care, none singled out.

thin-line.scene_bg: Simple flat set with two or three pastel shapes, the character small in the frame.
thin-line.insert_bg: Plain cream paper background, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred with generous empty space.
thin-line.dark: Dark variant: same drawing style, but a dark grey-blue paper background with one warm light.

thin-line.dark_insert_bg: Dark grey-blue paper background, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred.

thin-line.suffix: no text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no signs, no labels, no watermark.

stickman-dark.label: Stickman sombre : silhouette noire à tête ronde, yeux blancs, sweat à capuche de couleur, décors peints au crépuscule (style Ifverse Tales)
stickman-dark.prefix: Flat vector 2D animation still, clean shapes, soft gradients, cinematic dusk lighting with purple and orange sky, painted city or interior set with depth, subtle film grain, 16:9 wide format.
stickman-dark.insert_prefix: Flat vector 2D animation still, clean shapes, soft gradients, dark navy background, 16:9 wide format.
stickman-dark.character: Recurring character: a stick figure drawn as a solid black silhouette with a large smooth round black head, two simple white oval eyes with a small star glint, thin black arms and legs, {costume}. Keep this exact character design in every image.
stickman-dark.costume: wearing a red hoodie with the hood down
stickman-dark.scene_bg: Full painted set at dusk with real depth, the character medium to large in the frame; any other people are the same black stick figures in hoodies of other colours (blue, grey, green).
stickman-dark.scene_bg_nochar: Full painted set at dusk with real depth; any people are black stick figures in hoodies of other colours.
stickman-dark.insert_bg: Dark navy background with a soft vignette, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred with generous empty space.
stickman-dark.dark: Night variant: same style, deep blue night, one warm orange light source (window, lamp, fire).
stickman-dark.dark_scene_bg: Full painted set at night, deep blue shadows, one warm orange light source.
stickman-dark.dark_insert_bg: Near-black navy background, nothing else drawn around the subject, the subject centred.
stickman-dark.pov_hands: the character's thin black stick arms and simple black hands visible at the bottom of the frame
stickman-dark.suffix: no text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no signs, no labels, no watermark.
